name: s81lk_kp4_dsyn-t2-COMMIT
purpose: S81 link KP4 decoder tile dsyn (align, syndromes, 3 RiBM) of the 4-tile cluster ot_s81_kp4_dec, 10-17. Bench = bit-exact equivalence of the cluster vs the 33a35eb7d decoder (+ rs544.py exactness) and the syndrome mutant DMUT 3.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81_kp4_dsyn u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -Irtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link/ot_s81_kp4_common.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link/ot_s81_kp4_bm.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link/ot_s81_kp4_dsyn.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81lk_kp4_dsyn/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81lk_kp4_dsyn/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81lk_kp4_dsyn --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81_kp4_dsyn  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-TILES2 10-17: four-tile re-split of the KP4 decoder cluster ot_s81_kp4_dec (replaces s81lk_kp4_deca / decb, REJECTED at their CTS gates: 259.2 um tiles, SRAM in the middle, clock on the S face; TT insertion 307-455 / 295-417 ps, spread 148 / 122 ps).  Cluster 2 x 2: dsyn SW (PMA in W), ddly NW, dchn SE, dout NE (beats out E); every seam registered at both pins.  Bit-exact vs the 33a35eb7d two-tile decoder on every output and cycle (tb_s81_kp4_eq: RTL same cycle, hardware view with all tile pin registers = reference + 2 cycles; mutants DMUT 2 / 3 and a one-short word seam FAIL).  dsyn: alignment on registered am_ok / p_v, syndromes on the arriving stream, 3 RiBM key-equation units and the 3:1 result select; no macro; 172.8 um square (deca std ~15.6k um2 less the SRAM -> util ~0.55; enc's 7k-sink 151-194 um tiles measured TT insertion 192-243 ps, spread 32); p_d full W face (3.3/um), x_q full N face to ddly, k_* full E face to dchn, clk S centre (cluster outer face). S81-TILES3 10-17 PARENT PITCH (coordinator 0co: 2x2 parent with aligned pitch, no gaps on link paths): hard children sit on the 43.2-um child lattice with >= 20-um channels, so every seam tile edge is a lattice multiple minus 21.6 um. dsyn 172.8 -> 194.4 square (4.5 x 43.2; util ~0.55 -> ~0.43): 21.6-um channels to ddly (N) and dchn (E) instead of 43.2. x_q now 4.32-118.8 = ddly w_d exactly (4.75/um), k_* = dchn's W-face ranges exactly, so both seams are straight 21.6-um hops; p_d full W face (3.0/um), clk S centre. RTL unchanged. S81-TILES5 10-17 (coordinator: route s81lk_kp4_dsyn-t2-5f0b4a343 EARLY_FAIL_CONGESTION GRT-0116 at 194.4^2 / util 43%): the congestion is NOT diffuse all-to-all XOR wiring (enc k4-1ed8f8336 was: overflow 114,794, M2-M5 91% over the whole core); here total usage is 57% (M2 69% / M3 71%), max overflow 2 tracks, 580 gcells all in ONE L-shaped corridor in the NW quadrant: a horizontal band ~y 80-95 from the W face to x ~75 and vertical bands x 65-95 up to the N face = the 544-b p_d (W, 181 um) -> x_q (N, 4.3-118.8, 4.75/um) pass-through turning the NW corner on top of the syndrome fan-in. Fix: outline 216 x 216 (5 x 43.2, keeps the 2x2 parent lattice), place density 0.30 (the closed enc recipe), util ~35%: +11% tracks across the corner and a sparser NW. p_d W 4.32-207.36 (2.7/um); x_q, k_* (dchn seam) and S pins unchanged relative to the origin. Parent: dchn / ddly / dout shift +21.6 E / N, outline 600.48 x 540.
